findings.title: Quickstart initialization conflicted with the committed lockfile
findings.impact: The earlier advertised first-run path could fail before a normal locked build.
evidence: README.md and docs/installation.md at review target
findings.residual_risk: A later exact-main hosted multiplatform package matrix passed; physical/interactive platform and security release gates remain separate and fail closed.

findings.title: Platform and architecture documentation lagged the integrated implementation
findings.impact: Incomplete platform wording could mislead support and security assumptions.
findings.residual_risk: The corrected platform/support wording passed current-source documentary/source/static validation and separate-reviewer adoption is recorded; broader platform/release certification remains separate.

findings.title: Current-source evidence was mixed with historical or skipped jobs
findings.impact: Historical tests or skipped jobs could be mistaken for current executed approval.
findings.residual_risk: Current evidence separates exact push checkout, PR synthetic-merge checkout, tree equivalence and skipped jobs. The review record remains repository-scoped assurance material.

findings.title: Contributor reporting instructions did not match available channels
findings.impact: Confusing reporting channels can delay or misroute reports.
evidence: Repository API: private vulnerability reporting enabled
findings.residual_risk: No response SLA, guaranteed triage time or changed disclosure setting is implied.

findings.title: Bounded review smoke selected zero-test libraries and relied too heavily on exit status
findings.impact: A green harness alone did not prove that every named package executed tests or that the expected fake effect/audit state was asserted.
evidence: 9 Policy + 7 Protocol + 5 semantic Composition library tests passed; structured fake-effect/audit assertions passed.
findings.residual_risk: This bounded smoke is intentionally not a full Graph/Effects or workspace certification. The separate-reviewer receipt closes R-007 for R16 authorship separation without converting the smoke into broader release certification.

findings.title: Federated MCP tools/list aggregation was bounded only after pagination
findings.impact: An authorized hostile MCP child could materialize more catalog entries than intended before the aggregate guard ran; no credential exposure or authority escalation was demonstrated.
evidence: Actions run 37101922029 / job 111143008612: 7/7 sandboxed federation tests passed.
findings.residual_risk: The bounded-pagination remediation has separate-authorship revalidation for R16 closure. This does not prove absence of every resource-exhaustion path or make upstream MCPs trusted.

findings.title: Independent adoption was required for review-authored assurance changes
findings.impact: Security-relevant review changes cannot supply their own independent approval.
findings.residual_risk: R16 authorship separation is satisfied. Broader release/platform certification remains governed by release-readiness.json and open R06/R18 environment gates.

findings.title: Direct review depth was initially incomplete for mandatory boundaries
findings.impact: Uninspected boundaries cannot be converted into a no-findings verdict.
evidence: R16_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json: twelve review areas with source locations and limitations.
findings.residual_risk: A repository review is not proof that every runtime/platform defect is absent. Separate-reviewer adoption is recorded for R16 closure; physical/interactive acceptance remains separate under R06/R18.

findings.title: No main branch protection or ruleset is configured
findings.impact: Repository settings do not enforce review/status requirements at the branch or ruleset layer. This is a governance observation, not evidence of an unauthorized change.
evidence: 2026-10-04 repository API observation: main branch protection endpoint returned 404 Branch not protected.
2026-10-04 repository rulesets endpoint returned an empty array.
findings.residual_risk: No repository-setting change is implied by this record; maintainers must decide whether to add protection or rulesets.

findings.title: Physical and interactive platform release gates remain open
findings.impact: Hosted/headless success does not establish the outstanding physical and unlocked-desktop conditions.
findings.residual_risk: No fake display, shared graphical authority or cross-OS inference is accepted as replacement.

limitations: This is durable repository-review evidence, not an external organizational security audit.
R06 and R18 physical/interactive certification remain separate from R16 repository review closure.
